documentation: Install certificate.pem, key.pem and chain.pem on the target system and restart the service.
renewalScriptTemplate: # Replace the certificate files on the target system and restart the service.

de.documentation: Installiere certificate.pem, key.pem und chain.pem auf dem Zielsystem und starte den Dienst neu.

documentation: Export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx, import it into the Local Computer certificate store and assign it to the IIS binding.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx into this folder first.
#Requires -RunAsAdministrator
$password = Read-Host -AsSecureString 'PFX password'
Import-PfxCertificate -FilePath certificate.pfx -CertStoreLocation Cert:\LocalMachine\My -Password $password

de.documentation: Exportiere die PFX aus HomeCA als certificate.pfx, importiere sie in den Zertifikatsspeicher Lokaler Computer und weise sie der IIS-Bindung zu.

documentation: Copy fullchain.pem to /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem and key.pem to /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key, then restart pveproxy.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem
cp key.pem /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key
systemctl restart pveproxy

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem nach /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem und key.pem nach /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key, dann pveproxy neu starten.

documentation: Import the certificate and key under System > Trust > Certificates and select it for the web GUI.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Import the certificate in the OPNsense web interface:
# System > Trust > Certificates > Add > Import an existing certificate
# Then select it under System > Settings > Administration > SSL Certificate.

de.documentation: Importiere Zertifikat und Schlüssel über System > Trust > Certificates und wähle es für die Web-GUI.

documentation: Place fullchain.pem and key.pem in the configured SSL directory and set ssl_certificate and ssl_key in configuration.yaml.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /ssl/fullchain.pem
cp key.pem /ssl/privkey.pem
ha core restart

de.documentation: Lege fullchain.pem und key.pem im konfigurierten SSL-Verzeichnis ab und setze ssl_certificate sowie ssl_key in configuration.yaml.

purpose: UniFi Network Controller and UniFi OS Console
documentation: Copy certificate.pem and key.pem to the UniFi appliance. On UniFi OS: Settings > System > Advanced > upload the TLS certificate. For a self-hosted controller: create a PKCS12 keystore and import it into /var/lib/unifi/keystore.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# UniFi OS: upload through the web interface under System > Advanced > Custom Certificate.
# Self-hosted controller:
openssl pkcs12 -export -in certificate.pem -inkey key.pem -certfile chain.pem -out unifi.p12 -name unifi -password pass:aircontrolenterprise
keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore unifi.p12 -srcstoretype PKCS12 -srcstorepass aircontrolenterprise -destkeystore /var/lib/unifi/keystore -deststorepass aircontrolenterprise -destkeypass aircontrolenterprise -noprompt
systemctl restart unifi

de.purpose: UniFi Network Controller und UniFi OS Console
de.documentation: Kopiere certificate.pem und key.pem auf die UniFi-Appliance. Bei UniFi OS: Einstellungen > System > Erweitert > TLS-Zertifikat hochladen. Bei selbst gehostetem Controller: Erstelle einen PKCS12-Keystore und importiere ihn in /var/lib/unifi/keystore.

documentation: HAProxy expects a single PEM file containing key, certificate and chain. Use the combined export (bundle.pem) or concatenate the files: cat key.pem certificate.pem chain.pem > /etc/haproxy/certs/service.pem.

de.documentation: HAProxy erwartet eine einzelne PEM-Datei mit Schlüssel, Zertifikat und Chain. Verwende den kombinierten Export (bundle.pem) oder füge die Dateien zusammen: cat key.pem certificate.pem chain.pem > /etc/haproxy/certs/service.pem.

purpose: nginx reverse proxy and web server
documentation: Copy fullchain.pem and key.pem into the nginx SSL directory (for example /etc/nginx/ssl/). In the server block, set ssl_certificate to fullchain.pem and ssl_certificate_key to key.pem, then reload nginx.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem
cp key.pem /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem
nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem in das nginx-SSL-Verzeichnis (z. B. /etc/nginx/ssl/). Setze im Server-Block ssl_certificate auf fullchain.pem und ssl_certificate_key auf key.pem. Dann nginx neu laden.

purpose: Cisco IOS/IOS-XE web interface and SSH
documentation: Import certificate and key through the Cisco CLI. Create a trustpoint, import the PKCS12 archive with 'crypto pki import <trustpoint> pkcs12' and assign the trustpoint to the HTTPS server.
renewalScriptTemplate:
conf t
no crypto pki certificate chain HOMECA
crypto pki import HOMECA pkcs12 terminal password <pfx-password>
ip http secure-trustpoint HOMECA
end
write memory

de.documentation: Importiere Zertifikat und Schlüssel über die Cisco-CLI. Erstelle einen Trustpoint, importiere das PKCS12-Archiv mit 'crypto pki import <trustpoint> pkcs12' und weise den Trustpoint dem HTTPS-Server zu.

documentation: Upload the PEM certificate and key to the switch via SFTP/SCP and import them into the PKI realm with 'pki import-certificate'. The exact commands vary by VRP version.
renewalScriptTemplate:
system-view
pki realm homeca
 certificate-file import file certificate.pem
 private-key-file import file key.pem
quit
return
save

de.documentation: Lade das PEM-Zertifikat und den Schlüssel per SFTP/SCP auf den Switch und importiere sie über das PKI-Realm mit 'pki import-certificate'. Die genauen Befehle variieren je nach VRP-Version.

documentation: Open DSM > Control Panel > Security > Certificate. Click Add > Import certificate. Upload certificate.pem as the certificate, key.pem as the private key and chain.pem as the intermediate certificate.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# DSM web interface: Control Panel > Security > Certificate.
# Alternatively as root, with CERT_ID set to the directory name below _archive:
CERT_DIR="/usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/${CERT_ID:?set CERT_ID to the DSM certificate directory}"
cp certificate.pem "$CERT_DIR/cert.pem"
cp key.pem "$CERT_DIR/privkey.pem"
cp chain.pem "$CERT_DIR/chain.pem"
synosystemctl restart nginx

de.documentation: Öffne DSM > Systemsteuerung > Sicherheit > Zertifikat. Klicke auf Hinzufügen > Zertifikat importieren. Lade certificate.pem als Zertifikat, key.pem als privaten Schlüssel und chain.pem als Zwischenzertifikat hoch.

documentation: TeamCity uses a Java keystore or an upstream reverse proxy. For direct HTTPS: export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx, import it into a Java keystore and configure the keystore parameters. Behind a reverse proxy: use the proxy's profile.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx into this folder first.
keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore certificate.pfx -srcstoretype PKCS12 -destkeystore /opt/teamcity/conf/keystore.jks -deststoretype JKS -deststorepass changeit -noprompt
systemctl restart teamcity

de.documentation: TeamCity nutzt einen Java-Keystore oder einen vorgeschalteten Reverse Proxy. Bei direktem HTTPS: Exportiere die PFX aus HomeCA als certificate.pfx, importiere sie in einen Java-Keystore und konfiguriere die Keystore-Parameter. Bei Reverse Proxy: Verwende das Profil des Proxys.
